native_equivalence.reader_numeric_contract: Per-edge sums consume contributing MI in unchanged manifest run order, binary64; emitted zero increments support; supporting-run mean remains sum/count. Graph target order remains expression marker order.
native_equivalence.reuse_recommendation: Reuse frozen saved-input DREAM metrics and graph bodies as native-equivalent with disclosed precision provenance. Reader-only change has direct numerical parity evidence and unchanged source at current develop. No new inference/replay needed for this comparison. Do not label frozen DREAM rows as directly run on the latest sequential binary.

limitations: Original N1/N3 final files round MI to six digits. Weight checks use the pinned full-precision baseline replay and relaxed replay. Old raw MI tokens are preserved; lost input precision is not recovered.
DREAM results reuse frozen saved-input native-equivalent graphs. The latest sequential binary was not directly rerun over all18 datasets for this report.
Input and network fingerprints are recorded values; only small auditJSON was freshly hashed.
Legacy uses original pc=1e-5; legacy_k20 is a distinct control and is excluded.
Adjusted scale-free R2 was computed from all 36 saved final graphs; dream_topology.tsv and topology_provenance.json record the method, versions and count/median checks.
N1/N3/N4 references incompletely label the universe; compare their P/R/F1 within dataset and use separately from complete-reference Systems Genetics A.

The precision17 MI build for N4/Systems Genetics A is identified by its recorded binary hash; the parent manifest does not supply a separate actual build source commit. Historical requested-develop and scientific-equivalence pins are recorded separately.
